summary: Strategic review complete. Genome score 52/100. 14 stuck UCs analyzed. Key decisions: (1) Promote email delivery and zero-conversions fixes to P0. (2) Retry both with corrected instructions. (3) Add two critical rules to dev agent: test file placement and commit verification. (4) Propose 3 pilot recruitment UCs be marked blocked_human — stop burning agent cycles on inherently human tasks. (5) 4 P0 UCs in needs_merge are unblocked pending CI/PR check. Human blockers: Resend domain verification and A2P 10DLC registration must be completed by Stojan.

priority_changes.reason: Blocking all outbound emails and conversion paths — direct blocker to first paying customer
Mission-critical: zero paying customers at Day 79/90

action_items.description: Retry: Fix Email Delivery — Resend Test Domain Blocks All Outgoing Emails. Previous attempt FAILED because test file was placed in product/lead-response/dashboard/tests/ instead of tests/. HARD CONSTRAINT: ALL test files must be in project-root tests/ directory (tests/e2e/, tests/integration/, or tests/unit/). Scope: update Resend sender config to use verified domain or a working test fallback. Expected: emails successfully delivered from the system; no 'domain not verified' errors in logs.
action_items.reason: P1 upgraded to P0. Previous failure was a test path error. Retrying with explicit path constraint.

action_items.description: Retry: Zero conversions — no paying customers from landing page. Previous attempt failed with API syntax error. Narrow scope: audit ONLY the Stripe checkout flow — find the broken link between 'Start Trial' button and Stripe session creation. Check: correct price IDs in env, checkout API route syntax, redirect URLs. Do NOT rewrite the landing page. Expected: clicking 'Start Trial' initiates a Stripe checkout session without 4xx/5xx errors.
action_items.reason: Day 79/90, $0 MRR. Retrying with tighter scope.

action_items.description: Verify and close UC fix-no-urgency-or-scarcity-mechanism: Commit ba14031e appears to have implemented the fix. Read that commit diff, confirm acceptance criteria are met (urgency banner visible, scarcity signal present), then mark UC as done if verified. If criteria NOT met, reopen with specific gap description.
action_items.reason: UC still in_progress but a named commit was merged. Verify before retrying.

action_items.description: Add rule: TEST FILE PLACEMENT — ALL test files MUST be placed under the project-root tests/ directory: tests/e2e/, tests/integration/, or tests/unit/. NEVER place test files in product/lead-response/dashboard/tests/ or any subdirectory outside of tests/. After writing a test file, verify the path starts with tests/ before committing. Verification will reject any test file outside tests/ and fail the task.
action_items.reason: 3+ dev tasks failed for this exact reason in the last 7 days.

action_items.description: Add rule: COMMIT VERIFICATION — Before reporting task completion, run 'git log --oneline HEAD -1' and confirm your commit is present. If no commit exists, you have not done the work. If nothing to commit, explain explicitly in your completion report with evidence — do NOT exit silently.
action_items.reason: 45 dev failures this week. Dominant failure mode: agents exit without committing.

action_items.description: Add rule: DEDUP CHECK — Before creating any task, query tasks table for recent done/in_progress/ready tasks for same use_case_id + agent_id. If one exists, do NOT create a new task — report the existing task ID instead.
action_items.reason: Product agent creating duplicate tasks causing 'Archived: duplicate' failures.

action_items.description: Mark 3 pilot recruitment UCs as blocked_human: fix-zero-real-pilots-recruited, fix-pilot-outreach-has-not-happened-11-days-left, fix-30-pilot-campaign-stalled-at-day-8. Update implementation_status to blocked with blocked_reason=blocked_human. Cancel pending retry tasks. Surface as human action items. No agent can perform direct human outreach.
action_items.reason: 3+ retry cycles exhausted. Every additional retry ($2-5) is wasted compute. Human action required.

human_action_items.description: Resend domain verification: Log into Resend.com and verify the production sending domain. All outbound emails are blocked until done.
human_action_items.elimination_proposal: DNS verification must be performed by domain owner. One-time 10-minute task.

human_action_items.description: A2P 10DLC registration: Complete Twilio A2P 10DLC form in Twilio console. No agent can submit this form. Without it, outbound SMS to non-trial numbers is blocked.

Pilot outreach (21 days left to Day 90): Use invite-pilot-signups.js to identify candidates, then do direct outreach. Fix-zero-real-pilots-recruited, fix-pilot-outreach-has-not-happened-11-days-left, fix-30-pilot-campaign-stalled-at-day-8 all require human contact.
human_action_items.elimination_proposal: First contact requires human touch. Automated follow-up possible once A2P + email domain are verified.

human_action_items.description: 4 P0/P3 UCs in needs_merge: feat-revenue-funnel-visibility, feat-subscription-funnel-tracking, uc-marketing-campaign-launch (P0) and 2 P3 lastTaskCreated fixes. Check GitHub PR CI status — auto-merge should trigger if CI is green.
human_action_items.elimination_proposal: If checkPRReviews() loop is running correctly, these auto-resolve when CI passes.

decisions.focus_today: Unblock email delivery (domain verification by Stojan) and retry the zero-conversions checkout fix with narrowed scope — these are the last technical blockers before any conversion from the existing 363 trial agents is possible.
